title: Kill all processes using a file or directory
summary: Forcefully terminate all processes that are currently accessing a specific file or directory. Use this if a file is stuck and you need to free it immediately.

steps.explain: Send the SIGKILL signal to all processes accessing the specified file or directory. This will forcefully stop them.

placeholders.name: FILE_OR_DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: Path to the file or directory whose users should be killed

warnings: This forcefully kills processes. Unsaved data in those applications will be lost.
Ensure you know which processes will be terminated before running this command.

rollback.explain: There is no direct undo for killing processes. You must restart the affected applications manually.
